newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse lifts halt on Laem Thong Bank.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse lifts halt on Laem Thong Bank.

text.p: Thailand's stock exchange said it had lifted a halt on trading ordered on small-sized Laem Thong Bank shares on Tuesday during the afternoon session.
The bourse said in a statement that the halt had been lifted because the bank had disclosed information to the exchange as required by market rules.
Laem Thong shares were being offered at between 25.50 and 26.00 baht per share when trading was halted.
The bank said in a separate statement that a misunderstanding about the timing of the filing of its financial statements to the bourse had resulted in the trading halt.
The bank posted an unaudited 1996 net profit of 239.01 million baht versus 203.39 million in 1996.
